name: EU Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU)
description: Statutory rules covering EU CRD 2011/83/EU prohibitions on pre-ticked subscription boxes and requirements for transparent cancellation mechanisms.

rules.title: Pre-Ticked Consent Box & Default Additional Payments / Add-Ons

statute.title: Prohibition of Default Options for Additional Payments
statute.plainExplanation: EU law strictly prohibits traders from inferring consumer consent through pre-ticked checkboxes or default options for additional payments or add-on subscriptions beyond the main purchase.

rules.explanation: The terms or checkout flow indicate that an additional recurring charge, add-on subscription, or optional payment is pre-selected or checked by default beyond the primary transaction.
rules.recommendation: EU Directive 2011/83/EU Article 22 prohibits default options (such as pre-ticked boxes) for additional payments. Consent for extra charges must be express and opt-in; otherwise consumers are entitled to full reimbursement.

rules.title: Statutory 14-Day EU Withdrawal Right Waiver

statute.title: Unwaivable Right of Withdrawal
statute.plainExplanation: EU consumers possess a statutory 14-day right of withdrawal from distance and digital subscription contracts that cannot be waived or contracted away.

rules.explanation: The clause purports to enforce a blanket waiver or forfeiture of statutory EU withdrawal rights. Note that Directive 2011/83/EU Art. 16 permits narrow exceptions for digital content if express consent and acknowledgment of loss of withdrawal are provided.
rules.recommendation: Under Directive 2011/83/EU Article 25, contractual clauses derogating from consumer withdrawal rights outside narrow Art. 16 digital exemptions are null and void across the European Union.

rules.title: Bundled Subscription & Tracking/Profiling Consent

statute.title: Unbundled Freely-Given Consent Mandate
statute.plainExplanation: Consent to behavioral advertising or profiling cannot be bundled into acceptance of subscription terms as a condition of service.

rules.explanation: The subscription contract conditions service access on blanket acceptance of behavioral tracking, advertising cookies, or automated profiling.
rules.recommendation: GDPR Article 7 requires data processing consent to be freely given, specific, and unbundled from subscription contract performance.
